source.note: Plan row 47 names this frog as the poly.pizza Quaternius frog (clips Frog_Attack, Frog_Death, Frog_Idle, Frog_Jump); poly.pizza is behind a Cloudflare challenge, so it comes from the same author's Easy Animated Enemy Pack (Jan 2019) on itch.io, which carries exactly those four clips. The itch page states CC0; the zip ships no licence file. Id frog-quaternius because the procedural models/frog.js stays. It is a red-eyed tree frog, modelled realistically (no cartoon head), so the height is real size: 0.045 m at rest (snout-vent about 9 cm, like the procedural frog). Colours follow the procedural frog on the noon script: skin #f0c2ae with iris-brown shade (threshold 0.1 so the shade lands under the jaw and limbs), cream belly, accent-red eyes with near-black pupils. Ground: every clip is clamped (the take-off push in Frog_Jump sinks a toe 8 mm, the lunge in Frog_Attack 5 mm, the flip in Frog_Death 6 mm; Frog_Idle 1 mm).
